arguments.command:
set -e
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"

# Seek to <3s but non-zero so previous steps back (not restart) even at shuffle tail.
./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py seek 1500 > /tmp/seek_resp.json
cat /tmp/seek_resp.json
sleep 0.5

state=$(./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect)
before=$(echo "$state" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['songInfo']['path'])")
before_pos=$(echo "$state" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['songInfo']['position'])")
shuffle=$(echo "$state" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['shuffle'])")
echo "Before: $before pos=$before_pos shuffle=$shuffle"

# One track transition: previous
./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py prev > /tmp/prev_resp2.json
cat /tmp/prev_resp2.json
sleep 1

after_state=$(./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect)
after=$(echo "$after_state" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['songInfo']['path'])")
after_pos=$(echo "$after_state" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['songInfo']['position'])")
after_shuffle=$(echo "$after_state" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); print(o['playback']['shuffle'])")
echo "After: $after pos=$after_pos shuffle=$after_shuffle"

python3 -c "import glob
paths=set(sorted(glob.glob('/opt/nothingness/media/*.opus')))
before=r'$before'
after=r'$after'
assert before in paths and after in paths
assert before!=after
print('OK before/after in fixture set; exactly one transition achieved')"
